Hi Sabrina — great talk today, thanks for carving out time. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Goal: 60–90 min Technical Deep Dive (TDX) with your infra/ML leads to validate latency/cost targets and review deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Suggested attendees (from Redwood): Ben Carter (solutions, infra optimizations), Marcus Lin (serving runtime lead), me for product and mutual action plan.
- We’ll cover: environment & data scope, model selection/quant profiles, latency/cost SLOs, caching/batching approach, and a short runbook for handoff.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Aug 5 — 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed Aug 6 — 11:00–12:30

If none of those work, send a couple of slots that fit your folks (Tom?) and we’ll adapt. I attached a draft agenda and a short preflight checklist — please skim the checklist and flag any mandatory security items we should prep before the call.

Attachments: [TDX-Agenda-Acme-20250730.pdf] (agenda draft), [TDX-preflight-checklist.txt] (short items).

Thanks — Olga

Hi Sabrina — Ben here from Solutions. Wed Aug 6 11:00–12:30 PDT works for me and I’ll lead the infra portion. Marcus confirmed he can join for the runtime/serving deep dive. 

Inline preflight (high level):
- VPC/private endpoints: Redwood Private supports VPC peering and private control plane; will prepare a short architecture sketch and call out KMS options (customer-managed KMS/HSM supported in Private).
- SOC 2 / audit logs: we have an SOC 2 report summary and sample audit-log schema; I’ll attach the summary to the meeting invite.
- Data scope: please confirm if test data will be used (recommended) or if you need demo on de-identified production snippets.
- Ports/Network: we’ll provide a minimal egress/IP allowlist for the session if you want to run live demos behind your firewall.

If you want the session limited to 60 minutes we can compress agenda items and skip the live demo. Otherwise 90 min gives us time for a short run.

I’ll let Olga finalize and send the invite. Attaching a one-pager runbook stub here.
